required_documents.name: VA Online GPD Application Portal Submission
required_documents.details: Application submitted electronically via VA dedicated online grant portal when open NOFO is released.

required_documents.name: Transitional Housing Model and Operational Service Plan
required_documents.details: Operational plan specifying chosen transitional model (Bridge Housing, Clinical Treatment, Low Demand, Service-Intensive, Hospital to Housing, or Transition-In-Place).

required_documents.name: Special Need and Target Population Service Strategy
required_documents.details: Targeted service plan if serving specialized cohorts: women Veterans, frail elderly, chronic mental illness, terminally ill, or Veterans caring for minor dependents.

required_documents.name: Per Diem Reimbursement and Cost of Care Budget
required_documents.details: Itemized daily per diem reimbursement calculation and operational cost breakdown for transitional supportive housing.

required_documents.name: Nonprofit Determination (501(c)(3) or 501(c)(19)) or Government Certification
required_documents.details: Official documentation of eligible status as 501(c)(3) or 501(c)(19) nonprofit, state/local government agency, or recognized Indian Tribal government.

required_documents.name: Permanent Housing Continuum of Care Partnership Letters
required_documents.details: Formal collaboration letters with local Continuum of Care, VA medical facilities, HUD-VASH, or SSVF programs for permanent housing placement.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov Active Registration and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI)
required_documents.details: Active entity registration on SAM.gov under 2 CFR Part 200 prior to award execution.

deadlines.when: Forecasted release expected around FY 2025 for FY 2026 awards

deadlines.what: FY 2027 Per Diem Only (PDO) & Transition-In-Place (TIP) NOFO
deadlines.when: Forecasted release expected around FY 2026 for FY 2027 awards

eligibility.summary: Eligible entities include 501(c)(3) or 501(c)(19) nonprofit organizations, state and local government agencies, and federally recognized Indian Tribal governments. For-profit entities are ineligible.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing is required for Per Diem Only or Special Need operational grants. Intermittent Capital grants require matching funds pursuant to 38 CFR Part 61.

review_criteria.criterion: Quality of Transitional Housing Program Design & Service Continuum
Demonstrated Capacity to Move Homeless Veterans to Permanent Housing
Coordination with Local VA Medical Facilities & HUD-VASH/SSVF

funded_activities.activity: Per diem reimbursement payments for the cost of transitional supportive housing bed-nights provided to Veterans experiencing homelessness.
Wraparound case management and clinical treatment for substance use disorders and mental health diagnoses.
Low-demand harm reduction transitional housing and hospital-to-housing recuperative care services.
Transition-in-place services where housing units transition into permanent leases for the Veteran resident.

submission_limits: Organizations may apply for multiple grant types or service models but must submit separate applications for each distinct housing site or project.
important_notes: THIS IS A GENERAL FORECAST ONLY. Formal applications are submitted through VA GPD online portal, not Grants.gov workspace alone.
Review 38 CFR Part 61 (VA GPD regulations) and 2 CFR Part 200 before applying.
Ensure current registration and active UEI on SAM.gov.
